_: The monkey. Drawn for pt-monkey-crocodile, reused by jt-crocodile-rock.
A CAST MEMBER IS DRAWN ONCE FOR THE CHANNEL, not once per film. 69 characters cover
323 stories (docs/02 §7), so this file is a fixed cost and every film that names
this character in its scenes.json `cast` gets these cells for nothing.
`canon` is the cell generated and checked FIRST; every other cell is then drawn with
it as an extra reference outranking all others (docs/02 §5.1). That is what stopped
the drift that ruined four rounds of generative video, and it is why cells must be

cells.monkey-sit: A small friendly cartoon monkey for a children's picture book, FULL BODY, sitting in three-quarter view with his tail curled, warm golden-brown fur, a paler cream face and belly, very large dark-brown eyes with a bright highlight, small pink blush ovals on the cheeks, a gentle closed smile, thick soft warm-brown outlines. Never frightening, no bared teeth.
cells.monkey-offer: The same golden-brown monkey, FULL BODY, three-quarter view, leaning down and holding out one open paw with a few small round purple jamun fruits in it, the other paw gripping a branch, eyes bright and friendly, mouth in a happy open smile.
cells.monkey-ride: The same golden-brown monkey, FULL BODY, seen from the SIDE facing LEFT, sitting upright as if perched on something, both paws holding on in front of him, tail curled behind, eyes wide and trusting, small closed smile.
cells.monkey-laugh: The same golden-brown monkey, FULL BODY, side view facing LEFT, head thrown back laughing with his mouth open in a wide happy laugh, one paw on his belly, eyes crinkled shut, tail up.
cells.monkey-climb: The same golden-brown monkey, FULL BODY, seen from the side, climbing upward with both arms stretched up above his head and legs mid-stride, tail streaming down behind, eyes wide and determined, mouth closed.
cells.monkey-call: The same golden-brown monkey, FULL BODY, side view facing LEFT, sitting on a branch and calling downward with both paws cupped around his mouth, eyes bright, mouth open in a shout. Cheerful, not angry.
